data.name: Overclocked: A History of Violence
data.detailed_description:
Tendo como pano de fundo uma tempestade catastrófica que assola a cidade de Nova Iorque, Overclocked explora uma condição humana arquetípica, mas atual: a violência. Este thriller psicológico mistura elementos assustadores de ficção com estruturas narrativas inovadoras. Overclocked mapeia as áreas difusas onde memórias e ilusões, sonhos e realidade, perpetradores e vítimas colidem.

O psiquiatra do exército, David McNamara, é chamado ao Hospital Forense de Staten Island, em Nova Iorque, para prestar consultoria num caso que exige a sua perícia em psiquiatria forense. Com a tarefa de explorar as mentes de cinco jovens, homens e mulheres, que foram encontrados aterrorizados, a gritar e sem memória, faz descobertas alarmantes à medida que começa a explorar cautelosamente a psique dos seus jovens pacientes. Ao longo do jogo, os jogadores alternarão entre seis personagens diferentes neste arrepiante thriller psicológico interativo.

Principais Características

  • Experimenta Overclocked de várias perspetivas jogando com seis personagens diferentes ao longo do jogo
  • Explora 45 locais diversos com cenários pré-renderizados densamente animados
  • Técnicas de narrativa inovadoras criam uma experiência de jogo única
  • Conhece e interage com um elenco de personagens intrigantes, cada um com a sua própria personalidade
  • As personagens ganham vida com movimentos fluidos e expressões faciais realistas criadas com a tecnologia Emotion FX 2
  • Cenas cinematográficas projetadas com técnicas avançadas de câmara pioneiras em longas-metragens
  • Visuais excecionais melhorados por efeitos de sombra e shader, efeitos de partículas atmosféricas em tempo real (chuva, neve, relâmpagos) e iluminação dinâmica
  • Sistema de diálogo exclusivo baseado em ícones

reviews.review:
[h1] Overclocked: A History of Violence is a classic style point-n-click that despite its compelling thriller storyline and well-done voice acting becomes drawn-out and has unintentional moments of hilarity as a result of its low budget. [/h1]

Overclocked will primarily appeal to those who are fans of detective or thriller genre storylines. At its best Overclocked begins to feel reminiscent of Heavy Rain, 7even, or Zodiac, while never reaching the heights of any of those narratives. I was intrigued by the story it presented and found the character you play as to be a flawed, interesting character but moments that are meant to be gravely serious had me laughing more than being disturbed largely because the character models look a bit dated and silly.

[h2]+GOOD+[/h2]
Intriguing Mystery / Thriller Story that keeps you guessing until the end
Pretty good voiceacting from all of the (sparse) cast
Good soundtrack that at-times sounds Industrial
Classic Point-n-Click
Moon logic on the minimal side. Most solutions "make sense"
Interesting pacing via triggering memories / flashbacks of the patients to then explore

[h2]-BAD-[/h2]
Too few locales to explore. You spend a lot of time just bouncing between the same 7 screens of your hotel room and the psych ward.
Annoying system of replaying audio recordings to trigger memories in the patients. If these had somehow been marked as 'completed' or 'already used' in your PDA, it would have made selecting the next correct one much more fluid.
Minimal interaction with NPCs. You'll talk to the hotel receptionist a lot but other characters in the background (most of them just standing around in the rain with no umbrella for hours on-end) are window dressing.
Super goofy / funny cutscenes when one specific character starts to become unhinged. Rather than it being disturbing or effective, I found myself laughing at these scenes because of the manner they were presented.
My playtime isn't accurate on here (I left the game running and stepped away numerous times..) however Overclocked will take about 8-9 hours to complete. There is no reason it should be this long. The plot progression is divvied out at a drip-feed, which is intentional but at a certain point I started to think it was taking too long to get to the point. 
Some pretty rough-looking CG cutscenes. 

[h2]~HMM~[/h2] 
Overclocked likely won't blow you away but if you're looking for an intriguing thriller / detective / mystery type of game, it may fit the bill. I would recommend looking up some actual gameplay to see if you can accept its budget-y, somewhat dated presentation. I found the characters to be well-done and was invested in the story overall, however I do think it started to overstay its welcome. -I just saw this retails at 14.99- HAILLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL no! Wait for a significant sale. I think I snagged it for a couple bucks. 

Didn't love it. (Enjoyed it overall) 
Didn't hate it.
